note: Redundant/ungrammatical أظنني أنني and tense mismatch with English present.
Arabic has no politeness marker corresponding to 'Please'.
Current Arabic lacks the object represented by English 'it'; add ذلك to preserve meaning and avoid collision with row 22.
Orthography/case: حذاؤك is the correct nominative form in this nominal sentence.
كم رائع أنت describes how wonderful/nice the person is; 'How nice of you!' instead praises an act.
